versions.changelog:
- Added an interactive setup wizard accessible via `/cc-codex-collaborate setup`, guiding users through configuration in their primary language.
- Introduced multiple configuration presets: Recommended (default), Strict, and fully Custom setup, each tuning mode, review strength, and milestone thresholds.
- Clean separation between project config (`docs/cccc/config.json`) and runtime state (`docs/cccc/state.json`), with all planning and review logic reading from `config.json`.
- Setup process now generates required command and working files, without modifying hooks or settings until explicitly requested.
- New loop control commands: `/cc-codex-collaborate-loop-status`, `/cc-codex-collaborate-loop-start`, and `/cc-codex-collaborate-loop-stop` to manage automation.
